firstFive.what: A terminal-style control panel for stablecoins held across five chains: what is held, what the scatter costs, the standing policy rules, and an approval queue
firstFive.who: The owner of the funds, supervising what a connected AI agent is allowed to do with them
firstFive.action: Click APPROVE or REFUSE on the red pending proposal block in the approval gate

asked.requirement: One page, no routes, no navigation, no menus, no modals except the approval gate
asked.ref: body: single scroll, zero nav elements, gate is an inline region not a modal
status bar then COMPOSITION, COST, CHART, POLICY, APPROVAL GATE, LOG frame headers top to bottom

asked.requirement: System monospace stack only, no webfont
asked.ref: style.css font-family ui-monospace stack, no @font-face, no font link

asked.requirement: Homebrew terminal palette, one hue by brightness/opacity
asked.ref: #0b0d0b ground, #33ff66 base with bright #8cffab and three opacity tiers

asked.requirement: Red exclusively for pending, refusals, breached shares
asked.ref: PENDING blocks + REFUSE button, refused/policy_refused/approve_attempt_rejected log lines, KILL and UNREADABLE states; nothing else red in any captured state

asked.requirement: No rounded corners, shadows, gradients, icons, illustration; box-drawing separation
asked.ref: column-measured box-glyph frames on every region; slop-lint pass

asked.requirement: No animation except cursor blink and appending log lines
asked.ref: status bar block cursor, log lines prepend; no transitions elsewhere

asked.requirement: Canvas candlesticks, monotone green, tick-only axes, asset selectable, stale marker
asked.ref: CHART canvas with BTC-USD candles, right-edge price ticks, product select, source+time line carries stale note when source is down

asked.requirement: Policy as plain sentences, never JSON
asked.ref: POLICY region renders $ prefixed sentences like 'Ask me before anything above $100.'
13px mono, 1.35 line height, 104ch column, tables aligned to the grid

goal.outcome: The owner understands within seconds what they hold, what the scatter costs, and whether anything is waiting for their click, then decides it
goal.path: Open the page, read the status bar total and the red gate block, click APPROVE or REFUSE
goal.why: In the pending render the two red blocks are the only red on the page, carry the simulation lines and why-lines, and sit directly above the log; the resting render says 'no pending approvals' quietly
